D5/S3/Arith/AbsoluteValues/OstrowskiClas.name: D5.S3.Arith.AbsoluteValues.OstrowskiClassification.rational_absolute_value_classification
D5/S3/Arith/AbsoluteValues/OstrowskiClas.signature: theorem rational_absolute_value_classification (f : AbsoluteValue ℚ ℝ) (hf : f.IsNontrivial) : f ≈ Rat.AbsoluteValue.real ∨ ∃! p : ℕ, ∃ (_ : Fact p.Prime), f ≈ Rat.AbsoluteValue.padic p
